t.E965.agn: In the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E965.body: When consumed in excess, it may cause gas and diarrhoea in the gut.
t.E965.eff.0.t: May cause gas, bloating and diarrhoea (laxative effect); in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols
t.E965.eff.1.a: At 50 g per day in 15% of volunteers and at 60 g in 30% (3 days); 35 g per day with meals for 10 days caused no significant change in stools
t.E965.eval: Polyol (sugar alcohol): in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols; avoided in sensitive gut (FODMAP) diets.
t.E965.prod: Obtained from sugar or starch by hydrogenation (a chemical process).
t.E965.regx.0: The warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E965.summary: A polyol (sugar alcohol) produced from starch. Used in sugar-free chocolate, confectionery and chewing gum.
t.E965.what: A sugar alcohol (polyol): it provides sweetness and bulk in sugar-free products and retains moisture.
